  MINUTES  OF THE REGULAR  MEETING
  OF THE LA VERNE  PLANNING  COMMISSION
  WEDNESDAY,  JULY 10, 2024

  ACTION  MINUTES

REGULAR  MEETING -  6: 30 p. m. -  Chairperson  Simison  called the meeting  called to order at
6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE  OF ALLEGIANCE -  Led by Chairperson  Simison

ROLL CALL  Commissioner  Keny Chang,  Commissioner  Jeremy  Conrad,  Commissioner
  Erin Duffy, Vice- Chairperson  Thomas Allison, and Chairperson Jason
  Simison.

Commissioners  present: Chang,  DuB and Simison
Absent:  Allison and Conrad
Advisory Staff Present: Community  Development  Director  Eric Scherer and Assistant  Planner
Parker Stringfellow.

PUBLIC  COMMENT -  None

PUBLIC  HEAR! NGS

Case No. 63- 24CUP -  1473 Foothill Boulevard -  Conditional  Use Permit  to operate
Rebirth Lifting Club during late-night hours presented by Assistant Planner Parker
Stringfellow -  The applicants  Walter Pineda and Armando  Salazar of Pineda Salazar Property
Management  were present at the meeting.

RECOMMENDATION:
Staff and the Development  Review  Committee  recommend  that the Planning  Commission
approve Case No. 63- 24CUP  by adopting  Resolution  No. 1326 and affirm a categorical
exemption  from the California  Environmental  Quality  Act based on this staff report and the
findings  and conditions  contained  in the attached resolution.

Chairperson  Simison  opened public  comment.  There were no comments.

Commissioner  Chang had questions regarding  staffing.

It was moved by Ms. Dufff and seconded by Commissioner  Chang to approve Case No. 63-
24CUP.  The motion  carried by a 3-0 vote.

PLANNING  COMMISSIONER  COMMENTS -  Chairperson  Simison  complimented  City staff
for an awesome Fourth of July.

Commissioner  Dufff thanked  Assistant  Planner Gabriel  Rivera  and Planning  Intern Valerie
Chin for their five- star service at the Planning  Counter.
 DIRECTOR  COMMENTS -  Mr. Scherer spoke about the Metro A Line funding, train testing,
and tour. Mr. Scherer also provided an update on the 1941 White project's approval  and spoke
about current retail vacancies.

ADJOURNMENT - The meeting  was adjourned  at7:20 p.m.

Respectfully  submitted,

Natalie  Hiatt

Adm inistrative  Secretary
